blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator-judge Robinhood Padilla dared the prosecution in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial to investigate him, following repeated remarks during the proceedings that public officials and their families should lead simple and modest lives. Defense witness Chadrin Parian confirmed on the 43rd day of the trial that Duterte’s husband, Atty. Manases Carpio, paid for the shoes of a children’s basketball team Elite Philippines after a competition in Kuala Lumpur in Malaysia in 2025. Carpio, a co-parent and manager of the team, spent P256, 882 at a Nike store there. READ: Duterte impeachment witness shows Carpio buying shoes for youth […]...
